name: WAV export
description: Exports the score's sound as a WAV file (File → Export → WAV Audio): 16- or 24-bit or 32-bit float, at 44.1 or 48 kHz, set in Plugins → WAV Export Settings….

tools.name: WAV Export Settings…
tools.description: Picks the bit depth and the rate of File → Export → WAV Audio: kept with OK, forgotten with Cancel.
